decoder: gemma-2-2b-it-Q8_0.gguf needs ~2.5 GB resident at quant int8int8 + 1.6 GB KV + 2.6 GB reading the checkpoint (the .gguf stays mapped resident for the whole load) = 6.7 GB; this machine currently has 7.0 GB of memory available (budget 4.9 GB = 70% of that).
  Loading it would page to swap rather than run, so it was NOT loaded.
  Re-run goinfer-serve with -stream-weights: it caches the model as a sidecar .giw once, then pages weights out of it on demand instead of holding them all resident.
  Or run a smaller model.
  Set GOINFER_NO_FIT_GUARD=1 to load anyway if this machine really fits it
